PROJECT MANNEQUIN STYLE LOCK. Create an exact 5x2 ATTACK ANIMATION SOURCE SHEET for the supplied ARCHIVE KNIGHT identity pilot and approved idle sheet. Preserve the exact faceless ivory crested helm, cyan memory slit, asymmetrical broken-arch LEFT pauldron, smaller right shoulder, violet sternum core, warm-ivory plates, deep-plum joints, dark-indigo rigid split tabards, gold fasteners, heavy boots, and integrated cyan-edged archive blade attached along the RIGHT forearm. The pilot is absolute identity authority. Never redesign, recolor, swap sides, mirror asymmetry, detach or change the blade, add a shield, or change proportions. Match mannequin/Ryu/Goku contours, broad cel shading, clear fighting poses, and anime fighting-game finish.

One square 2k image containing exactly TEN complete full-body combat poses in a clean 5 columns x 2 rows layout, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Same SCREEN-RIGHT THREE-QUARTER camera, body scale, head size, lighting, and baseline. Pose order is the runtime row-4 contract: 1 ready stance; 2 fast left pommel jab; 3 armored right-shoulder drive; 4 heavy downward forearm-blade cleave; 5 wide cleave follow-through with restrained violet core flare; 6 low front kick; 7 driving mid kick; 8 high roundhouse while blade stays guarded; 9 compact airborne blade check with both feet visible; 10 Archive Burst release with blade extended and one tight cyan-violet energy edge around the weapon only. Strong startup, active, and recovery silhouettes. No giant effects, no motion blur, no pose touching another cell.

Perfectly uniform pure white background edge to edge. No grid, labels, text, logo, floor, cast shadow, scenery, extra characters, extra limbs, loose weapons, cape, floating armor, cropped crest, cropped blade, cropped feet, overlap, photorealism, PBR, rust, grime, microtexture, or painterly blur. Generous white clearance around every pose.
